not_claimed: proof or refutation of an affine asymptotic limit

design.statistical_unit: whole translation row; all radii, orientations, q and beta cells paired
design.peeling_contract: remove extreme hull vertices only; retain collinear non-vertices

primary.row_score: W_j=equal-weight mean over 3 orientations and 3 q of (d-B), at R=512

predeclared_secondary: all seven beta losses by R, orientation and q

oracle.domain_justification: h0>=0.925; grid hull contains disk radius 0.925-sqrt(2)/R; for R>=256, q_abs>=0.85*(0.925-sqrt(2)/256)>0.78 and q_abs<=0.95
requirements: max empirical a3 method/refinement difference <=3e-9 over q_abs in [0.75,1]
oracle.future_q_evaluation: mechanical evaluation of frozen oracle at q_abs determined by new initial hulls; fully logged; no phase, speed or exponent refit

randomization.selection: uniform without replacement by sequential rejection of blacklist and duplicates
randomization.seed_timing: after protocol/code/oracle/manifest freeze and before any new evaluation
randomization.master_seed_format: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters [0-9a-f], representing 256 unsigned bits in big-endian order
randomization.seed_source: recorded launch procedure; public beacon not required
randomization.generator_version: exact NumPy version frozen in the environment manifest before launch
randomization.master_stream_initialization: PCG64(integer value of the 256-bit big-endian master-seed hex string)
randomization.rejection_rule: reject candidate if in the exact historical blacklist or already accepted; continue sequential calls until 64 acceptances
randomization.accepted_order: acceptance order is the frozen row order; never sort or permute it
randomization.auxiliary_randomness: digest=SHA-256(bytes.fromhex(master_seed_hex) || 0x00 || domain_ascii || 0x00 || bytes.fromhex(frozen_manifest_sha256)); initialize PCG64(int.from_bytes(digest,'big')); domain labels are distinct recorded ASCII strings and no independently supplied seed is allowed
randomization.pairing_key: exact tx,ty,denominator and provenance; never row number alone

components_measured_separately: second engine in actual planned regime
historical_cost_pilot.jarvis_rule: if exhaustive Jarvis is prohibitive, report measured diagnosis and propose an exact faster independent control or bounded geometric subplan before any seed or draw
historical_cost_pilot.cost_failure: prepare a new quantified prospective version before any draw; do not choose n after viewing new losses

second_geometry_engine.scope: all layers through q=0.85 at R=256 and 512 and all three orientations
requirements: same exact extreme-vertex sets up to cycle/reversal
same adjacent target layers and nesting
same Minkowski weights and coefficients within frozen floating tolerance
second_geometry_engine.divergence_rule: block analysis; never delete the divergent row

integrity.blind_geometry_correction: keep identical coordinates, exclude no row, hash corrected code, and recompute every dependent result before contrast analysis
integrity.incomplete_campaign: do not reinterpret as reduced-n design

documentary_corrections: P05 is another sample from the same dyadic law as P06-P19, not a different law.
Only three trajectories have nine eligible cells after exclusion; the other thirteen trajectories in the affected historical group retain ten.
